The '''Club Vertica Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] situated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was owned by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Godoba]] the Shrewd.

==History==
On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], well-known for its clubs and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], Club Vertica was quickly considered as an exclusive experience. During its first several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the casino was run by a wealthy backer and strictly monitored admittance; only the wealthiest, best-dressed and most beautiful patrons could hope to enter the casino. The rare exceptions were the people invited by Club Vertica's mysterious owner.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], these restrictions were loosened, which started rumors that the casino had been sold. In spite of this, much of the casino's old reputation remained intact; everyone knew that Club Vertica was the perfect place to be on the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] if you wanted to look important.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Club Vertica Casino}}</ref>
